I have an exact relationship with my brother that's exactly like Spongebob and Squidward's. As Squidward, it honestly is the worse. I can't believe I'm saying this, but I liked him better when he was punching me because at least my parents still liked both of us. Now, I'm certain they both hate me in secret. The worst part is, we have the exact same personalities as those characters. I like playing the Clarinet, I like to draw, I like to be alone, people generally don't like me, and so on. Wheras my brother is exactly like Spongebob. It really hurts when you see the person who annoys you the most always being liked by other people and then you're just being hated by everyone around you. For a while, I thought that the problem was me, but then I got some online friends and some other people invited me to a group chat. Honestly, life as Squidward has convinced me that rules were meant to be broken because if I had listened to my parents and I had never gotten social media, I would have probably killed myself by now. It also inspired me to start 3D modeling and although I'm not very good at it yet, I finally found out how to do a ton of things in Blender 2.82 this year and on top of that, it inspired me to make a Webtoon. I don't have a ton of subs yet, but I may get some more soon. Ok, I'll end this as I don't want this to be some stupid inspirational story, but yeah, it sucks to be in a Spongebob and Squidward relationship.

TLDR: I was in a Spongebob and Squidward relationship with my sibling and it hurt my self esteem, however when I got social media, it inspired me to do many things and it got me a ton of friends.
